summary: Full regression + new-feature testing for EIBIL changes: (1) consent-less employer verify-candidate (lookup by PAN/email/EIBIL ID), (2) questionnaire-based evaluations + admin question CRUD, (3) admin algorithm/apply/activate + manual adjust applied instantly, (4) Record Drawer / Data Explorer / Admin Activity, (5) admin re-rate + employeeProfile.currentScore override posts ledger. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 52 -> 70 tests. All 70 PASS. Frontend: verified all data-testids and flows on employer verify page (consent-request panel GONE, candidate-report renders instantly, reports table + Open button present, non-existent PAN shows 'No EIBIL' error), employee rahul /employee/consents viewers-table shows the view entry and notification bell shows 'Acme ... viewed your EIBIL score', employer /employer/evaluations evaluation-modal with 4 sections + live-dim-* widgets, admin /admin/questionnaire (question-new), /admin/algorithm (algo-step-1..6, algo-k, algo-save, sim-new-score, sim-delta), /admin/score (manual-adjust, activate-config-*), /admin/data (data-model-User, data-model-Evaluation, rows clickable, record-drawer with record-tab-details/linked/history + record-edit on editable types, no record-edit on AuditLog read-only), /admin/activity (activity-mine/all toggles).

issues: Pre-existing Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning on initial render — cosmetic only.

Rate limiter (429) triggers quickly when the admin SPA burst-fetches multiple collections on page nav; harmless in local but will spam logs under preview-proxy shared IP. Already noted in iter_1 as code-review item (trust proxy).

critical_code_review_comments: scoreConfigService.applyConfig uses the full req.body as a draft and spreads it into ScoreConfig; there's no server-side bounds validation (e.g., sensitivityK could be set to -1000). Consider Joi-validating applyConfig payloads mirroring the schema.

adminDataService.update loads the doc twice (lines 83 and 109 `fresh`); on save, if the user-provided `changes` include a mongoose virtual or a schema-rejected path, the before/after audit will record keys the save silently dropped. Consider validating against allowed Set before setting.

questionnaireService.scoreAnswers: if requireAll=false and a dimension has no answers, dimsFrom returns the fallback (default 75). That means a half-filled draft eval will carry 75 for untouched dimensions — may be unexpected when the draft is later displayed to admin.

reportService.lookupForEmployer: uses consent.findCandidate(query) which returns the FIRST match — if query is an ambiguous short string (e.g., 'rahul'), it may match any email containing it. Verify consent.findCandidate uses exact-match on PAN/eibilId/email only (works for the tested exact strings).
Backend hot-reload is OFF (per the agent-note). Any future admin fix must be followed by `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`.

The questionnaire admin edit endpoint uses the generic crudService; there's no server-side validation that options points are 0..100 or that at least 2 options exist for mcq/yes_no — the UI validates but the API accepts arbitrary payloads.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all required data-testids and flows verified

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md unchanged (admin@eibil.in / Admin@12345 with 2FA devOtp, hr@acmetech.in / Demo@12345, rahul@demo.in, priya@demo.in, anita@demo.in).

rca of the issue: No defects discovered. All acceptance criteria for consent-removal, questionnaire-driven evaluations, admin algorithm/adjust, record drawer, admin activity, and admin re-rate / score override pass end-to-end at both API and UI layers.
